title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark Leads U.S. Open
items.text: Wyndham Clark is at -7 overall through 1 hole, holding a six-shot lead over Scottie Scheffler and others at -1 at the U.S. Open.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy Falls Out Of Contention
items.text: Rory McIlroy dropped out of U.S. Open contention following a poor back-nine performance despite his strong major season including a Masters win.
